business_summary: NORINCO International Cooperation Ltd. engages in the engineering construction and services, resources and equipment supply chain, power operations, and industrial manufacturing businesses in China and internationally. The company is involved in engineering and logistics; acquisition and sale of coking coal resources; warehousing; export of heavy equipment, commercial and mining vehicles, and equipment, petroleum equipment and services, logistics automation systems, and other products; construction projects for rail transit, power energy, municipal engineering, mining, and power plants, etc., as well as warehousing and logistics services; heavy vehicles and coal; investment, construction, and operation of power energy projects; and production and sale of tinplate packaging containers, including tinplate spray, chemical, milk powder, and sundry cans. It also provides transportation, mining, solar and wind power, investment management, and freight forwarding services. In addition, the company engages in general contracting of industrial, energy, transportation, and civil engineering construction projects; dispatch of labor personnel; aluminum profiles, aluminum doors and windows, aluminum products, building curtain walls, and indoor and outdoor decoration projects. NORINCO International Cooperation Ltd. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
